sources.title: Rookery README
sources.locator: Features; install; backends; capability center; data handling
sources.finding: Local resident daemon with master/worker orchestration, isolated Git worktrees, native desktop/CLI/Slack, Claude/Codex selectable per surface. Capability packs with digest trust; automation, attention bell and local usage. Own native CLI login/API keys. App source Apache2; provider SDK separate.

sources.title: Rookery Fleet lifecycle
sources.finding: Persistent worker IDs/worktrees/branches; lazy SDK resume after daemon restart if session/worktree exist, otherwise orphaned. Stop keeps branch; discard destroys. Checkpoint restores only non-running work. GitOps does not commit/push/openPR; worker bash does when instructed.

sources.title: Rookery Master and worker turns
sources.finding: Master turns serialized, workers have FIFO pending followups. Worker completion notifies parent, persisted pending notification retry. Per-turn trusted capability overlays and separate generated Codex homes; live reload explicitly required for worker.

sources.title: Rookery Automation architecture
sources.finding: Persisted cron/once and Slack triggers route to master or worker; cron overlap skipped, Slack concurrent, once rearmed after crash for at-least-once. Older doc omits newer budget/trigger work, checked against pinned source.

sources.title: Rookery Settings
sources.finding: Settings stored locally, secret getters write-only; binds127.0.0.1 default, warns for plaintext token on remote bind. Slack allowlist fail-closed; API-key fallback to native CLI OAuth.

sources.title: Rookery Data model
sources.finding: Local SQLite sessions/messages/worker events/automation runs, worker checkpoints and persistent memory. No org multiuser role matrix established.

sources.title: Rookery Third-party notice
sources.finding: Third-party Anthropic SDK is separately proprietary; main app Apache-2.0 does not relicense dependency.

sources.title: Rookery desktop implementation
sources.finding: Accessible desktop README features are built by Electron/Vite with React/Monaco and bundled daemon dependencies.

sources.title: Rookery worker budget and recovery
sources.locator: consume turn_end; maxTurns; costBudgetUsd; abort-loop breaker
sources.finding: Worker checks per-send turn count, lifetime USD budget and repeated aborted/errored turns. Codex reports one subturn so maxTurns>1 does not cap Codex; cost budget is its runaway guard. Stops at observed result boundary, not hard prepaid guarantee.

sources.title: Rookery fleet implementation
sources.finding: Pinned code resumes background rows as idle with empty background task set, preserves budgets/mode, supports cross-provider handoff; no worker concurrency cap. Same worker reload keeps identity/worktree.

sources.title: Rookery automation implementation
sources.finding: Automation passes costBudgetUsd/maxTurns/provider to worker/master; untrusted Slack and worker results fenced with random nonce. Codex master accepts bypassPermissions only; provider fixed at creation.

sources.title: Rookery v0.6.0 release
sources.finding: Release v0.6.0 published 2026-10-19 with macOS arm64 DMG, Linux x86_64 AppImage and Windows x64 EXE assets. Release notes describe a Slack Stop button, Claude Agent SDK and Codex CLI updates and cost-accounting fixes. Capability claims stay scoped to pinned main, not a binary test.
